info.name: Global Needoru Theme
info.description:
Advanced Dracula layering hierarchy with professional visual depth and polish.

? Layering System (back to front):
• Base: #1e1f29 (main surface)
• Sidebar/Cards: #181921 (darker, recessed)
• Toolbar: #16171e (deepest depth)
• Hover: #1e1f29 (subtle lift)
• Dividers: #2d2e37 (soft separation)
• Accent: #ae79f8 (interactive pop)
• Text: #f6f7ee (readable everywhere)

✨ Features:
✓ 3-tier depth: #16171e → #181921 → #1e1f29
✓ Consistent 1-2 shade elevation
✓ Smart contrast on all layers
✓ Smooth state transitions
✓ Professional polish
✓ Depth without shadows

A masterclass in subtle elevation using only color values.
